evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with BC-063 which states that authenticated users submit sessions, creating incompatible permissions.

evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with BC-059 and BC-060 which imply that anonymous users submit and own sessions.

evaluations.rationale: Implies registration is required to submit a session, conflicting with BC-060 where an anonymous user submits a session directly.
